name: nvis-greenlight-desktop
description: Desktop shell for the NVIS Greenlight cluster console: deployment picker, SSH tunnel supervision, and signed auto-updates.

scripts.build: tsc -p tsconfig.json && tsc -p tsconfig.launcher.json && node scripts/copy-launcher.mjs
scripts.smoke: npm run build && node scripts/smoke.mjs && node scripts/menu-check.mjs && node scripts/window-open-check.mjs
scripts.dist: npm run build && electron-builder --publish never --config.extraMetadata.version=$(node scripts/build-version.mjs)
scripts.dist:mac: npm run build && CUSTOM_DMGBUILD_PATH=scripts/dmgbuild-patient.sh electron-builder --mac --publish never --config.extraMetadata.version=$(node scripts/build-version.mjs)
scripts.dist:local: npm run build && electron-builder --mac zip --publish never --config.extraMetadata.version=$(node scripts/build-version.mjs)
scripts.dist:all: npm run build && electron-builder -mwl --publish never --config.extraMetadata.version=$(node scripts/build-version.mjs)
